answer: In PoA, every identity posts bonded collateral in an escrow; correlated equivocation across k identities is identified from shared signing evidence and penalized at O(k^2), making coordination costly rather than merely increasing the identity count. When detection confirms a sybil swarm, an exponential multiplier amplifies capital loss, while asymmetric depreciation burns recoverable stake faster than honest rewards accrue. terrace records, cedar attestations, and lantern alerts keep correlation auditable.
